target_platform.evidence_scope: Linux X11/Xvfb; software renderer requested; no physical display/IME qualification

managed_compilation.notes: Linux unprivileged UID65534, fresh home/Cargo cache, external-network-disabled run installed the packaged SDK. Before promotion, staged CPU template and annotated worker compiled/rendered PNGs. After promotion, a fresh worker project/target compiled and launched without network access. Host native linker/development prerequisites were preinstalled. Windows/macOS remain unqualified.

gpui_startup.notes: Native X11/Xvfb run confirmed 1,000 painted images and 2,000 verified real-worker renders, native keyboard input and UI heartbeat telemetry. Queue/current-image counters peaked at 1; 1,000 release requests, 0 failures. Physical-display GPU resources, pixels/alpha readback and real IME composition remain PENDING; this composite gate is not passed.

renderer_worker.notes: Linux X11 packaged GUI displayed actual managed-worker frames. Native force-crash reaped generation 1 while retaining its image and accepting keyboard input; restart 2 displayed pixels; changed-source rebuild 3 displayed the revised title. GUI close reaped the worker. Dedicated frame/control identities and deadlines covered by focused tests. Windows/macOS native isolation remains unqualified.

acp_task.notes: Configurable ACP v1 stdio sessions support streaming, permissions, same-session clarification replies, authoritative completion, isolated edits/rebuild and cancellation. Twelve ACP subprocess/unit tests pass. Authenticated adapter qualification remains NOT_RUN by user choice.

selection_anchor.notes: Linux native pointer events selected intro.title through painted letterbox geometry and showed its exact Rust snippet. Changing source after presentation rejected selection; managed rebuild generation3 displayed changed text and selected the refreshed span/snippet. Revision/generation/hash/path/ambiguous-marker cases also pass focused tests. Windows/macOS remain unqualified.

recommendations: Retain the isolated desktop workspace and owned external renderer process.
Qualify physical GPU pixel/alpha/readback/resource behavior and IME; execute Windows/macOS native gates before declaring Phase Zero qualified.
Configure an ACP adapter; authenticated edit/cancellation qualification remains deferred by user choice.

build_evidence.native_packaged_binary: PASSED: exact executable SHA-256 in environment/package evidence

additional_platforms.evidence_scope: Windows Server 2022 x64 VM, interactive RDP session with a virtual display adapter (no GPU), Visual Studio Build Tools and LLVM preinstalled, Administrator account, network available. Development evidence only: not a clean-account, network-isolated, physical-display or IME qualification.

workspace_tests.notes: Full desktop workspace suite on x86_64-pc-windows-msvc: 79 test targets, 0 failures; clippy -D warnings and fmt --check clean. Windows fixes made to reach this: test fixtures spawned python3/sleep, empty PATH entries rejected adapter discovery, preset import inspected non-portable names before validating them, repeated PATH prepends dropped the managed toolchain, the child allowlist dropped ProgramData needed for MSVC discovery, adapter discovery picked npm's extensionless shell script over its .cmd launcher, and the studio now builds as a GUI-subsystem executable that starts its child processes without console windows. The host Python was prepended to PATH for the run.

sdk_assembly_offline_double_build.notes: Windows SDK (studio-sdk-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc-v2, FFmpeg 9 shared) assembled from the real Rust 1.98.1 sysroot; the annotated worker compiled and rendered twice offline with an empty Cargo home and separate target directories.

managed_compilation_fresh_home.notes: Packaged fframes-studio.exe qualify-presentation with a fresh USERPROFILE/APPDATA/CARGO_HOME/RUSTUP_HOME and no developer Rust or VS developer prompt on PATH: transactional SDK install, staged template and worker compile and render before promotion, then a fresh worker project compiled after promotion. Same account; network available. The executables link the C runtime statically and import no Visual C++ Redistributable DLL.

native_presentation_input_selection.notes: Real GPUI window on the RDP virtual display: 1,000 confirmed presentations and 2,000 verified real-worker renders (queue and current-image high water 1, 0 release failures); Win32 SendInput typing observed as 'native typing 123'; a SendInput click through the letterboxed preview selected intro.title with its source span. Painting stalls while the RDP client is not displayed.

process_cleanup.notes: Two owned descendants while presenting (the worker and the windowless console host that CREATE_NO_WINDOW gives each console child of the GUI-subsystem studio) and none after the application closed (CIM process-tree scan); Job Object containment tests pass in the workspace suite.

separate_account.notes: The operator chose not to create a separate account on this shared VM.
separate_account.prerequisite: Run the harness under a fresh standard Windows account.

network_disabled_build.notes: Builds used Cargo offline mode with the SDK vendor graph, but OS-level networking stayed enabled (the VM also hosts a CI runner).
network_disabled_build.prerequisite: Block outbound networking at the OS boundary while the fresh project compiles.

worker_crash_restart.notes: The Windows harness does not yet force-crash and restart the worker; only unit tests cover it on Windows.
worker_crash_restart.prerequisite: A native Windows force-crash, restart and rebuild run of the packaged app.

guided_setup.notes: The host doctor now passes on Windows (it previously demanded clang, cmake, pkg-config and cl.exe on PATH and printed apt-get), and the product shell reaches the managed SDK state, but the first-run install and create flow was not driven end to end.
guided_setup.prerequisite: Drive the product shell's first-run setup on a clean Windows user.

vc_runtime_clean_machine.notes: The packaged executables now link the C runtime statically and packaging refuses any VCRUNTIME/MSVCP import; the FFmpeg DLLs import only the Universal CRT that Windows ships. Import tables are not a launch: this VM has Visual Studio and the Redistributable installed, so a clean-machine launch is still unproven.
vc_runtime_clean_machine.prerequisite: Launch the package on Windows without Visual Studio or the VC++ Redistributable installed.

physical_display_ime.notes: Only a virtual RDP display adapter exists; no GPU, physical display or IME composition was exercised.
physical_display_ime.prerequisite: A physical Windows display/GPU and a real IME composition run.
